note: On by default, with the same URL checks as links. Images load without a click, so a hostile reply can send data to its own server: pass `images: ['https://your-cdn.example']` or `images: false` to limit that. Reference-style images and sources without a leading slash (`train.jpg`) render the alt text. Titles are ignored.

note: Shown as text, because raw HTML can run code, except attribute-free `br`, `b`, `strong`, `i`, `em`, `u`, `s`, `del`, `ins`, `mark`, `small`, `kbd`, `sub`, and `sup`, which become elements.
